items.title: Hoda Kotb Addresses Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade Being Postponed
items.summary:
Hoda Kotb is speaking out after the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed for the first time in its 100-year history.

“It’s OK,” Kotb, 62, said on the Wednesday, November 25, episode of Late Night With Seth Meyers . “We waited 100 years for this parade… we’re gonna wait two more days. We’re gonna have it on Saturday. It’s gonna be a beautiful, sunsplash day.”

Kotb said the weather forecast for the parade’s original date on Thursday, November 26, “was not gonna be fun.”

“The winds were like tropical storm force. There are a bunch of kids who were marching and people with the balloons,” the former Today show cohost reasoned. “Safety first.”

How to Watch the 2026 Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade After Postponement 

“The people have been preparing this 100-year parade, [they] have been working tirelessly for a year-plus,” Kotb continued. “The musical acts are incredible. So imagine spending all that time painting every little bit of every float, wondering if the float is going to fly away somewhere.

“So the good news is, to me, I’m relieved. Saturday’s gonna be amazing. Everybody’s still hanging out. We’re gonna watch it anyway,” Kotb said of the parade’s new date on Saturday, November 28.

She added, “And during the parade piece that’s usually on tomorrow, guess what? We’re gonna watch an old parade and you won’t know the difference, OK? It’s gonna be spectacular.”

Macy’s announced the postponement of its annual Thanksgiving Day parade in New York City due to adverse weather conditions in a statement to Us on Wednesday.

items.t: Hoda Kotb Addresses Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade Being Postponed

items.title: U2 Performs Posthumous Duet With Late Dolly Parton at NFL Game
items.summary:
U2 paid tribute to the late Dolly Parton with a posthumous duet at the NFL’s Thanksgiving Eve game.

The Irish rockers projected archival footage and audio of the country music icon for a hybrid live performance of their collaborative track “Torn” during halftime of the Green Bay Packers and Los Angeles Rams’ Wednesday, November 25, game at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.

In between their ’80s hits “Sunday Bloody Sunday” and “Where the Streets Have No Name,” U2 joined a worldwide Netflix audience in celebrating the life and legacy of Parton, who died at age 80 in August following a brief battle with cancer .

“Torn” is thought to be the final song Parton recorded , having worked on the track with Bono in Nashville only two months before her death. The gripping ballad posits the hope of reconciliation in a family divided over their differences.

View this post on Instagram 

“I can’t deny this passion and desire / But I know it has to burn me standing this close to the fire,” Parton sings. “What am I supposed to do? And how am I supposed to choose? / I love ’em both, and I just feel so torn.”

The track was officially released on U2’s 16th studio album , Carnaval de Luz , earlier this month. Parton shares a writing credit on “Torn” with U2 and Snow Patrol’s Johnny McDaid .

“When she got ill, she got out of her bed to sing this song,” Bono, 66, told Rolling Ston e in August. “And you can hear that. And I can’t even listen to it now.”

The musician revealed that he initially reached out to Parton about potentially collaborating on a completely separate project.

items.title: Britney Spears Spending Thanksgiving With Family in Louisiana: Report
items.summary:
Britney Spears will reportedly celebrate Thanksgiving with her family after a long period of estrangement.

Us understands that Britney, 44, is in Louisiana ahead of the holiday on Thursday, November 26. The “Toxic” singer’s parents , Jamie Spears and Lynne Spears , still own property in Kentwood, Louisiana, where Britney, her brother Bryan , 49, and sister Jamie Lynn , 35, spent their formative years.

Britney has been joined in Louisiana by sons, Sean Preston , 21, and Jayden James , 20, and plans to visit her parents and siblings over the festive period, per TMZ .

Us has reached out to Britney’s representative for comment.

“I’m so very sorry for bringing up past issues, but I think I did because I realized I needed to protect my heart,” she wrote via Instagram on Saturday, November 21.

The pop icon went on to write, “It’s the way I love and when I love you, I REALLY love you. My stubbornness is childish and embarrassing. Thoughts on the past, I’m obviously human and there actually might be something to those things I said phycology [sic] wise, either way I’m sorry to my family bringing up those memories.”

Britney said she was eager to work out her differences with the Spears family after years of separation.

items.title: Celebrity Deaths of 2026: Duran Duran’s Andy Taylor and More
items.summary:
Hollywood mourned the deaths of some of its most legendary stars in 2026.

In August, news broke that The Sopranos alum Vincent Pastore and former The Challenge winner Tyler Duckworth died. Dolly Parton also passed on August 25, one day before Tim Curry ‘s death.

In September, Disney Channel star Carla Jeffery , legendary activist Gloria Steinem and jazz singer Cassandra Wilson died at the respective ages of 33, 92 and 70. Later that month, model Presley Gerber died at the age of 27.

One month later, news broke that former Big Brother contestant Amber Siyavus died at the age of 46. Breaking Bad alum RJ Mitte died at age 34 in October, while legendary actor Patrick Stewart died at age 86 following a battle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia.

In November, Yes, Dear alum Anthony Clark ‘s longtime manager confirmed to Us that the actor died at age 62 on November 10. Steven Hack , an original member of Broadway‘s Cats , later died following a sudden and unexpected cardiac event. Duran Duran announced in a joint statement that its legendary guitarist Andy Taylor died on November 23 “following a long and courageous battle with prostate cancer.” He was 65.

items.title: Duran Duran Guitarist Andy Taylor Dead at 65, Band Shares Loving Tributes
items.summary:
Duran Duran has announced the death of its iconic guitarist Andy Taylor “following a long and courageous battle with prostate cancer.” He was 65.

“Andy passed away peacefully at home, surrounded by family, on Monday 23rd November,” the “Hungry Like the Wolf” band announced in a Wednesday, November 25, statement .

Andy became one of the classic “Fab Five” members of Duran Duran when he joined the New Wave band in 1980, along with singer Simon Le Bon , keyboardist Nick Rhodes , drummer Roger Taylor and bassist John Taylor . (Andy, Roger, 66, and John, 66, were not related.)

The group went on to sell more than 100 million records worldwide and received a coveted star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1993. They were inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2022. (Andy left Duran Duran originally in 1986 but later returned for a five-year reunion stint between 2001 to 2006.)

The Most Shocking Celebrity Deaths of All Time: Hayden Panettiere and More 

Andy was also part of the 1980s supergroup the Power Station, along with Duran Duran bandmate John, Chic drummer Tony Thompson and frontman Robert Palme r. Formed in 1984, the Power Station scored U.S. Top 10 hits with “Some Like It Hot” and a cover for T. Rex’s “Get It On.”

Le Bon, 68, announced during Duran Duran’s Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony in 2022 that Andy was unable to attend after being diagnosed with stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer.

“Andy was there at the very beginning of our story,” Duran Duran said on Wednesday. “From the moment he arrived in Birmingham from the North East with a guitar and…
items.t: Duran Duran Guitarist Andy Taylor Dead at 65, Band Shares Loving Tributes

items.title: Aaron Rodgers' Most Controversial Moments On and Off the Football Field
items.summary:
Aaron Rodgers is one of the best-ever quarterbacks to play in the NFL, but it’s often his antics off the field that get the most people talking.

Rodgers — who was the Green Bay Packers superstar quarterback for 18 seasons before joining the New York Jets in 2023 and the Pittsburgh Steelers in 2025 — came under fire in November 2021 when it was revealed he misled people about his COVID-19 vaccination status when he told reporters that he was “immunized” when he hadn’t actually been vaccinated.

The athlete defended his use of the phrase, calling it “the truth.”

“Had there been a follow-up to my statement that I’d been immunized, I would have responded with this: I would have said, ‘Look, I’m not some sort of anti-vax-flat-Earther. I’m somebody who’s a critical thinker,’” Rodgers later explained on the Pat McAfee Show . “I march to the beat of my own drum. I believe strongly in bodily autonomy, [in the] ability to make choices for your body, not to have to acquiesce to some woke culture or crazed group of individuals who say you have to do something.”

He raised eyebrows again in November 2026, when his controversial comments about Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy amid his benching ended with the team releasing the quarterback hours later.

items.title: Steelers Coach Mike McCarthy Breaks Silence on Aaron Rodgers' Allegations
items.summary:
Mike McCarthy has broken his silence after Aaron Rodgers was shockingly cut from the team after he publicly slammed the Pittsburgh Steelers head coach.

“It was a process that went on throughout this week,” McCarthy, 63, told reporters on Wednesday, November 25, when asked what initially led to Rodgers, 42, being benched as the starting quarterback ahead of the Steelers’ highly-anticipated Friday, November 27, matchup against the Denver Broncos.

McCarthy, who previously coached Rodgers during the quarterback’s time at the Green Bay Packers, explained, “We got to a point, we’d talked about some things, communication, things like that, and there was an ultimatum made [that was] clearly out of his job description. So it was my decision to bench him.”

Aaron Rodgers Goes Scorched Earth on 'Unwell' Mike McCarthy After Benching 

After having “private conversations” with Rodgers , he was informed that backup quarterback Mason Rudolph would be stepping in for Friday’s game.

Rodgers addressed the coach’s decision during an appearance on the The Pat McAfee Show on Wednesday, where he proceeded to claim that McCarthy is “unhealthy.”

The four-time NFL MVP alleged that McCarthy had fallen asleep during team meetings, missed multiple team walkthroughs and was unwilling to connect with the team’s defensive players.

Mike McCarthy and Aaron Rodgers during Green Bay Packers’ tenure. Kevin C. Cox/Getty Images 
 Rodgers also claimed that his longtime coach had yelled, “One, two, three, Packers!” when breaking a huddle during the Philadelphia Eagles game, hinting that McCarthy wasn’t…
items.t: Steelers Coach Mike McCarthy Breaks Silence on Aaron Rodgers' Allegations

items.title: Tiffani Thiessen, 52, Gives Candid Update on Future Hip Replacement Surgery
items.summary:
Saved By the Bell alum Tiffani Thiessen is offering fans a candid update on her upcoming hip replacement surgery.

“As of right now, I am not getting it because of just the timing of travel, and I start season 2 very soon, so I’m looking at doing it next year after I finish season 2 of my show,” Thiessen, 52, said while speaking to Woman’s World in an interview published on Wednesday, November 25, referring to her Disney+ show Coven Academy .

“So right now, it’s kind of steroid shots to kind of help me through — which, my last one I just got last week helped tremendously,” she continued. “I even played pickleball for four hours and didn’t feel a thing, so we’re good.”

She added of her future surgery, “It is definitely something in my very near future that I need to get done. And that’s okay. It’s part of it, right? Part of getting old and being active.”

Tiffani Thiessen, 52, Says She Needs Hip Replacement After Sharing Diagnosis 

The actress revealed on a November 10 episode Tom Papa ’s eponymous podcast that she needs to undergo a surgical hip replacement after learning she had “hip dysplasia” while seeking a second medical opinion.

“I have to get a hip replacement — I do,” she revealed at the time. “I was a dancer when I was younger, which was a good thing, [and] I have a torn labrum, that’s one issue I have. Then, I found out, going to my second opinion, … I have hip dysplasia.”

 Hip dysplasia, according to the Cleveland Clinic , occurs when bones in the hip joint no longer properly fit together.
